description: Cut and publish the next version of @hancrafted/markdown-harness. Releases are tag-driven — bump the version, push a vX.Y.Z tag, and GitHub Actions publishes to npm over trusted publishing (OIDC). This skill drafts release notes from the commit log and stops at a review gate for approval before anything publishes. Use when the user wants to release, publish a new version, ship, bump the version, or push a release tag.
